example.title: Dana Point Harbor fishing pier at Baby Beach
example.place: Dana Point Harbor, Dana Point, Orange County, CA

brief: A short T-ended fishing pier into the sheltered harbour beside a small swimming beach: a concrete deck on concrete piles with a plain pipe rail, benches and lamp posts, the replica tall ship moored nearby. Three photos (from the bluffs). Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

names.sign: SOLANA POINT FISHING PIER · NO SWIMMING OFF PIER
